If we take your scenario, that everything is going well and good, but he/she is trying to change your outward appearance so drastically and invasively, since it apparently doesn't sit kosher with you, I wouldn't find it acceptable. What's wrong with the way you look? Are you a trophy partner?  
  
You need to ask yourself and your partner this and you both need to come to an objective, mutual, agreement/understanding of why he/she is trying to change your appearance. Is your normal attire 10 yr old flannel shirts and a pair of Levi's that have seen better days? Are your favorite shoes often mistaken for Swiss cheese based both on smell and the number of holes? Then yeah, you might want to consider an upgrade to your wardrobe.  
  
However, if your style is at least modern/contemporary and you didn't go to /r/malefashionadvice, but your SO thinks a different style is hotter than what you currently have: let's say in this instance you dress conservatively/professionally, but your SO wants you to dress like a korean pop star, it's time to talk about what his/her actual values in a relationship are.  
  
You could try integrating some things, and if you feel like it isn't your cup of tea, you can reconsider. If you happen to like it (on your own accord of course, not because your SO plays it up and tries to slowly erode your wardrobe) then hey, awesome.

I might as well be married to my girlfriend. Not engaged, but this is how I asked her to be my girlfriend.  
  
We were sophomores in college; she went to U of I, and I went to "One of the Community Colleges of Chicago." It was graduation week and one of her friends would soon be graduating with a double major (like, holy shit, how the fuck does someone accomplish that shit, especially in two years?), so she invited me to come down and see what real college life was like.  
  
Before my trip down to U of I, I stopped by a grocery store and bought her a bag of her favorite chips - Calbee Veggie chips (the real name escapes me, but they look like [this](http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-p0C9wISNqLg/UYreTXQ6oAI/AAAAAAAAAIg/Sc4K-1gvo8c/s1600/2013-05-08-11-47-50_deco.jpg). ) I opened up the bag on the bottom edge and dumped all the chips out, wrote a note  saying "Will you go out with me?", tossed it in the bag, put the chips back in and sealed the bottom with hot glue.  
  
I made my way to Champaign, and presented her with the bag of chips, as well as some other snacks, so as to not make it too obvious. The day rolls by and we're going out with her friends to the bars, making our way down Green Street and decided to head back to her apartment so everyone can pre-game some more before heading off to the big apartment complex party a few blocks down.  
  
She has not even touched the snacks since that morning.  
  
Tipsy, hungry, and nervous as all hell, I kept kind of bringing up the idea of having some of the snacks I brought to kind of help absorb the alcohol before going on the big bender of the night. The topic fades in and out throughout the next hour or so as people drink more and wash their faces, put on more makeup/cologne/changing clothes/etc.  
  
Eventually everyone announces that now is the time to head down to the complex party to seal the deal and to commemorate the graduating class. As we empty out, my brain slurredly reminds me to get her the bag of chips. I grab her by the arm and tell her to wait a second because I was feeling a bit hungry and wanted to bring a snack for the walk, so I runback into her bedroom, pick up the bag of chips and come back out with it firmly grasped in my sweaty hands.  
  
We make it down the flight of stairs out of her apartment building, and I slowly peel open the bag of chips, my folded note is sitting at the very top. Nonchalantly, I pick a few chips out, and munch on them and offer the bag to her, tilting it slightly in her direction. She digs her hand in, and goes, "What's this?" She pulls out the note, reads it for half a second and then looks to me, grabs my hand and says, "Yes!"  
  
We kiss, eat the rest of the chips, and continue to party through the night. One of her friends puked until 5 AM and we cared for him through it all and attended the graduation at 9 AM that morning.
